measurement_convention: Times are per-process observed elapsed phases on a workstation shared by concurrent agents. Summing them is work accounting, not end-to-end wall time.
Process peak RSS is not global concurrent peak RSS. It includes all prior phases of the same process and adaptive checkpoint peaks are cumulative.
Physical-map validation includes CAR tests, geometry, reconstruction, exact coefficient comparisons and symmetry checks. Exact SOS validation alone does not include those costs.
A reused physical audit is listed only after exact semantic map/constant/objective/equality hashes match.
Missing construction times remain null; phase sums then omit that unrecorded phase. Failed and abandoned runs are retained separately; uninstrumented invocation overhead may remain uncounted.
Discovery of q20 directions required full-T2 optimization and audit. The13.82s six-block replay is a deployment cost, not the total discovery cost.
Literal O dimensions count original full Fock polynomials before further fixed-sector identities; cone entry counts and dual square counts are distinct.

operator_rank_stage.dimension_convention: Original full Fock-space polynomial span, before further fixed-sector identities. Cubic net+1 and adjoint net-1 have disjoint canonical monomial supports; PQG has degree<=2.
operator_rank_stage.rank_proof: Exact rational dependency relations provide upper bounds; Gaussian elimination modulo proven prime1000003 gives matching lower bounds in every charge/momentum sector.
operator_rank_stage.bound_proof: Every retained dual square has its cubic part in this closed span and its linear part in PQG. All coefficient-residual positivity SOS operators have degree<=2 and lie in PQG. D4/spin closure permits certificate twirling, hence the inherited exact lower bound is valid for the literal operator-space relaxation.
